date.as_written: yāte bde śrutidantighoṭakamite māse 'site phālguṇe, govindasya tithau di[[ne]] śaśadhare ... saṃ 784

notes: The catalogue records the scribe as Bhūdeva. In the metrical verse 'bhūdevo likhati sma tāṃ gaṇapatir ggovindasevārataḥ', bhūdeva ('brāhmaṇa') is an epithet/caste title in apposition to the scribe's personal name Gaṇapati.
